Class Course

java.lang.Object
edu.odu.cs.cs350.Course
All Implemented Interfaces:
Cloneable, Comparable<Course>
public class Course extends Object implements Comparable<Course>, Cloneable
Represents a course offered by ODU with the course name, number of enrolled students, total capacity of enrolled students, and the list of course offerings.
